1: The equality $2+a=\dfrac{9a}{2a+1}$ holds when: A. $a=-2$  B. $a=-1$  C. $a=1$  D. $a=2$
3: The number $\log_{\sqrt{2}}4^{8}$ equals: A. 2  B. 4  C. 32  D. 16
5: The greatest integer satisfying the inequality $\dfrac{1}{6}-x\ge\dfrac{2}{3}x+4$ is: A. $-3$  B. $-2$  C. $2$  D. $3$
7: The sides of triangle $ABC$ lie on the lines $y=\frac{2}{3}x+2$ and $y=-x+2$, and on the $Ox$ axis of the coordinate system (see figure: the two lines meet above the axis at vertex $C$, and meet the axis at vertices $A$ and $B$). The area of triangle $ABC$ equals: A. 10  B. $\frac{5}{2}$  C. 5  D. $\frac{3}{2}$
8: The point $P=(-3,7)$ lies on the graph of the linear function $f$ given by $f(x)=(2m-1)x+5$. Therefore: A. $m=\frac{1}{6}$  B. $m=-\frac{1}{6}$  C. $m=\frac{5}{6}$  D. $m=-\frac{5}{6}$
9: The graph of the quadratic function $f(x)=-x^2+6x+4$ is a parabola with vertex at the point $(3,q)$. The number $q$ equals: A. 4  B. 7  C. 9  D. 13
12: The lines given by $y=(m-2)x$ and $y=\frac{3}{4}x+7$ are perpendicular. Then: A. $m=-\frac{5}{4}$  B. $m=\frac{2}{3}$  C. $m=\frac{11}{4}$  D. $m=\frac{10}{3}$
13: The arithmetic sequence $(a_n)$ is defined for every natural number $n\ge1$. Its fourth term equals $a_4=2020$. The sum $a_2+a_6$ equals: A. 505  B. 1010  C. 2020  D. 4040
15: The points $A=(80,-1)$ and $B=(-6,-19)$ are vertices of a right triangle $ABC$, in which the angle at vertex $C$ is right. The center of the circle circumscribed on this triangle is the point with coordinates: A. $(43,-10)$  B. $(37,10)$  C. $(43,10)$  D. $(37,-10)$
16: In right trapezoid $ABCD$ the side lengths are: $|AB|=8$, $|BC|=5$, $|DC|=5$, $|AD|=4$ (see figure: right angles at $A$ and $D$, with $D$ and $C$ on top, $A$ and $B$ on the bottom). The tangent of the acute angle $ABC$ in this trapezoid equals: A. $\frac{4}{3}$  B. $\frac{4}{5}$  C. $\frac{3}{4}$  D. $\frac{3}{5}$
17: The points $A=(1,-2)$ and $C=(0,5)$ are endpoints of a diagonal of square $ABCD$. The perimeter of this square equals: A. 12  B. 20  C. 28  D. 48
18: The area of an isosceles triangle equals $25\sqrt{2}$. The angle between the equal legs of this triangle equals $45^\circ$. Each of the legs of this triangle has length: A. $10\sqrt2$  B. $5\sqrt2$  C. 5  D. 10
20: The slant height of a cone is 2 longer than the radius of its base, and the lateral surface area is greater than the base area by $2\pi$. The radius of the base of this cone equals: A. 3  B. $2\pi$  C. 1  D. $\pi$
21: The volume of a regular quadrilateral pyramid, in which the height is twice as long as the base edge, equals 144. The length of the base edge of this pyramid equals: A. 18  B. 36  C. 3  D. 6
22: The base of a regular prism is a square with side 2. The diagonal of the prism forms an angle of $60^\circ$ with its base (see figure: a rectangular box with the space diagonal drawn from a bottom vertex to the opposite top vertex, marking the $60^\circ$ angle at the base). The height of this prism equals: A. $\frac{\sqrt2}{2}$  B. $4\sqrt2$  C. $\frac{\sqrt6}{4}$  D. $2\sqrt6$
23: How many four-digit natural numbers are there in which the thousands digit and the hundreds digit are greater than 4, and each of the remaining digits is less than 6? A. $4\cdot4\cdot5\cdot5$  B. $5\cdot4\cdot6\cdot5$  C. $5\cdot5\cdot6\cdot6$  D. $4\cdot3\cdot5\cdot4$
24: The variance of the set of four mathematics grades: 1, 3, 5, 3, is the number: A. 1  B. 2  C. 3  D. 5
25: An urn contains 9 balls: four red, three green and two white. One ball is drawn. The probability that neither a green nor a white ball is drawn equals: A. $\frac{4}{5}$  B. $\frac{4}{9}$  C. $\frac{5}{9}$  D. $\frac{6}{9}$
27: Given the numbers $a=3\log_2 12-\log_2 27$ and $b=(\sqrt6-\sqrt7)(3\sqrt6+3\sqrt7)$. The value of $a-b$ is an integer. Compute this number.
30: The three-term sequence $(x+2,\ 4x+2,\ x+11)$ is given. Compute all values of $x$ for which this sequence is geometric. (sum of solutions)
31: Line $k$ is inclined to the $Ox$ axis at an acute angle $\alpha$ such that $\cos\alpha=\dfrac{\sqrt3}{3}$. Find the slope (directional coefficient) of line $k$.
32: The points $A=(1,-1)$, $B=(6,1)$, $C=(7,5)$ and $D=(2,4)$ are vertices of quadrilateral $ABCD$. Compute the coordinates of the point of intersection of the diagonals of this quadrilateral. (sum of coordinates)
33: A symmetric coin is tossed four times. Compute the probability of event $A$, that the number of heads obtained differs from the number of tails obtained.
34: In a regular hexagonal pyramid $ABCDEFS$, whose base edge $a$ has length 8 (see figure), a lateral face is inclined to the base plane at an angle $\alpha=60^\circ$. Compute the cosine of the angle between a lateral edge and the base plane of this pyramid.
